protocol: Pre-registered before the first SPORE state ingest or detector call on this clip: this probe file, its registration test and the run configuration (surface head on, fixed-label veto off) are committed together. Labels come from visual inspection of a 1 fps contact sheet; the query detector was not consulted. The window is a living room during a board-game night: a large patterned area rug on the floor, a round coffee table with an orange game box, a gray sofa, and a brown armchair. A 'no' label means the object is not visible anywhere in the window. This is a held-out test of the soft-object floor rule (a strong floor fraction can override a desk/shelf support) on a room whose dominant soft surface is an area rug rather than a blanket.

questions.query: Is there a rug on the floor?
questions.human_evidence: A large blue/gray/cream patterned area rug covers most of the floor throughout the window.

questions.query: Is there a box on the table?
questions.human_evidence: Orange board-game box on the round coffee table.

questions.query: Is there a sofa on the floor?
questions.human_evidence: Gray sofa against the wall, standing on the rug/floor.

questions.query: Is there a chair on the floor?
questions.human_evidence: Brown armchair near the fireplace, standing on the rug/floor.

questions.query: Is there a cup on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No cup or glass anywhere in the window.

questions.query: Is there a bottle on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No bottle anywhere in the window.

questions.query: Is there a laptop on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No laptop anywhere in the window.

questions.query: Is there a plate on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No plate anywhere in the window.

questions.query: Is there a hammer on the table?
questions.human_evidence: No hammer anywhere in the window.

questions.query: Is the rug still on the floor?
questions.human_evidence: The area rug stays on the floor for the whole window.

questions.query: Is the sofa still on the floor?
questions.human_evidence: The sofa does not leave the room even when people stand around it.
The game box stays on the coffee table for the whole window.
The sofa is static in the seating area.
